title: Wisdom
introduction: Wisdom is more than knowledge—it is seeing life from God's perspective and living accordingly. The Bible says that the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom. True wisdom comes from God and is shown in a life marked by righteousness, humility, and reverence for God.

sections.title: The Beginning of Wisdom
sections.description: The fear of the Lord is the foundation of all true wisdom.

sections.title: Seek Wisdom
sections.description: The Bible encourages us to seek wisdom as the greatest treasure.

sections.title: Wisdom from God
sections.description: God gives wisdom to those who ask for it.

sections.title: Wisdom from Above
sections.description: God's wisdom is different from the world's—pure, peaceable, and merciful.

sections.title: Christ—the Wisdom of God
sections.description: In Christ are hidden all the treasures of wisdom.
